measurement: Size is determined by patient height. Adult Universal fits patients 5 ft 3 in. (63 in.) and taller. Youth Universal fits patients under 5 ft 3 in. (under 63 in.). No ankle measurement is needed. The universal design fits both left and right ankles. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
